title: Iran to Gulf States: Cooperate with US, and You'll Face Problems in the Strait
text:
Iran to Gulf States: Cooperate with US, and You'll Face Problems in the Strait"

"Iran's Army Spokesperson:"

""Some of these countries [the littoral states of the Persian Gulf] have fully cooperated with the Americans in recent years. Of course, they have taken advantage of this strait to sell billions of dollars' worth of their own goods and to export millions of barrels of oil from this region. They exploited our geopolitical capacity and then aligned themselves with the enemy. Well, from now on, our control over the strait will affect our relations with these countries. Any country that cooperates with the Americans will certainly face problems in the strait. Not everyone with harmful intent will be able to pass through, bring equipment and ammunition here, and then use them against us.
